name: Ability Doubler
description:
Doubles the effect of other gear abilities
attached to this gear.

name: Comeback
description:
Boosts some of your abilities for a short time
after respawning.

name: Drop Roller
description:
Tilting the Left Stick during a Super Jump lets
you perform a roll in that direction when landing.

name: Haunt
description:
Once you've respawned, reveals the position of
the players who splatted you.

name: Ink Recovery Up
description: Increases ink-tank refill rate.

name: Ink Resistance Up
description:
Reduces damage taken and improves mobility
when walking through enemy ink.

name: Ink Saver (Main)
description:
Decreases amount of ink consumed by your
main weapon.

name: Ink Saver (Sub)
description:
Decreases amount of ink consumed by your
sub weapon.

name: Intensify Action
description:
Makes Squid Rolls and Squid Surges easier to do
and steadies your aim when firing after jumping.

name: Last-Ditch Effort
description:
Boosts ink-recovery rate and weapon-ink
efficiency for the last 30 seconds of battle.

name: Ninja Squid
description:
Leaves no trace when swimming in inked ground
but slightly reduces swim speed.

name: Object Shredder
description: Increases damage dealt to all nonplayer targets.

name: Opening Gambit
description:
Boosts your speed while moving for the first 30
seconds of battle.

name: Quick Respawn
description:
Reduces respawn time after getting splatted
repeatedly without splatting any opponents.

name: Quick Super Jump
description: Increases Super Jump speed.

name: Respawn Punisher
description:
Increases respawn time and special-gauge spawn
penalty for you and any player you splat.

name: Run Speed Up
description:
Increases movement speed in Inkling or
Octoling form.

name: Special Charge Up
description: Increases special-gauge fill rate.

name: Special Power Up
description: Upgrades your special weapon.

name: Special Saver
description:
Reduces special-gauge decrease after
getting splatted.

name: Stealth Jump
description:
Hides your Super Jump landing point from
distant players.

name: Sub Power Up
description: Upgrades your sub weapon.

name: Sub Resistance Up
description: Reduces effects and damage from sub weapons.

name: Swim Speed Up
description: Increases movement speed in swim form.

name: Tenacity
description:
Fills special gauge automatically if your team
has fewer active players than the enemy.

name: Thermal Ink
description:
Allows you to track distant players hit with
shots from your main weapon.
